system.description:
You intuitively understand how to operate an unfamiliar object, vehicle, or device, no matter how alien, advanced, or bizarre - your morph simply finds the handshake.

You may make a COG Check to determine how to activate or use it, simply by looking at and handling it. This sleight does not provide any understanding of the principles or technologies involved, and it grants no access rights, credentials, or protected data - you simply grasp how to make it work. This sleight is only effective with unfamiliar devices; it provides no bonus when using devices with which you are familiar.
